column3: [alarmed] Whoa! Why are they cutting the gum?!
[gasps] Look! There's a tooth hiding up there!
[annoyed] Dude! You were supposed to come down years ago!
[confused] Hey! What's this gold chain for?!
[amused] Relax. They're pulling you down next to us.
[worried] How long is this gonna take?
[cheerful] A while. But we saved your seat!
This is an impacted canine: a tooth stuck under the gum and bone.
The dentist uncovers it and glues on a tiny button with a gold chain.
The chain hooks to the braces, and pulls it down gently.
It moves slowly, so it usually takes about a year.
